noncomputable def reconstructed (T : ℝ≥0) (hT : 0 < T) : Dual :=
  (4:ℕ) • HigherHeatAdaptedIntegralClosure.integral 2 (by norm_num) T hT (cubicInput T hT) +
  (6:ℕ) • secondChannel 2 T (quadraticField T hT) +
  (4:ℕ) • thirdChannel T (curveField 2 (by norm_num) T hT) +
  (-24*(T:ℝ)) • pairing 2 (by norm_num) T hT (core (1:Cylinder))

example (T : ℝ≥0) (hT : 0 < T) : cubicCurve T hT zeroTime = 0 := by
  change cubicCurve T hT (node 0 (prefixNode 0 0 (Nat.zero_le _))) = 0
  rw [cubic_curve_prefix, HigherHeatQuadraticItoData.prefix_zero,
    zero_pow (by decide : (3:ℕ) ≠ 0), map_zero, map_zero, map_zero]

example (T : ℝ≥0) (hT : 0 < T) :
    cubicCurve T hT ⟨1,zero_le_one,le_rfl⟩ =
      pairing 2 (by norm_num) T hT (core (terminalCylinder^3)) := by
  have ht : node 0 (prefixNode 0 (size 0) le_rfl) = ⟨1,zero_le_one,le_rfl⟩ := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    rw [HigherHeatQuadraticDualCurve.prefix_time]
    norm_num [size,HigherHeatDyadicLaws.gridSize,HigherHeatDyadicLaws.duration]
  rw [← ht, cubic_curve_prefix, HigherHeatQuadraticItoData.prefix_end, map_pow]
  rfl

example (T : ℝ≥0) (hT : 0 < T) :
    reconstructed T hT (core (1:Cylinder)) = -24*(T:ℝ) := by
  unfold reconstructed
  rw [← quartic_ito T hT, pairing_core_real, mul_one, terminal_moments]
  have hm := PseudoPolynomialStein.moment_multiple 4 (by norm_num) (-(T:ℝ)) 1
  norm_num at hm ⊢
  nlinarith [hm]

example (T : ℝ≥0) (hT : 0 < T) :
    Filter.Tendsto (fun n => pairing 2 (by norm_num) T hT
      (core (cylinderOf n (HigherHeatQuarticChannelLimit.quarticPolynomial n (fun _ => 1)))))
      Filter.atTop (nhds ((-24*(T:ℝ)) • pairing 2 (by norm_num) T hT (core (1:Cylinder)))) := by
  rw [← fourth_constant T hT]
  exact HigherHeatQuarticChannelLimit.constant_quartic_sums_converge T hT

example (n : ℕ) (T : ℝ≥0) (hT : 0 < T) (j : Fin (size n)) :
    pairing 2 (by norm_num) T hT (core (cylinderOf n ((MvPolynomial.X j)^4 * MvPolynomial.X j))) =
      HigherHeatFourthChannelSteps.correction n T hT j ((MvPolynomial.X j)^4) :=
  HigherHeatFourthChannelSteps.agreement_dual n T hT j _

example (T : ℝ≥0) (hT : 0 < T) :
    (pairing 2 (by norm_num) T hT (core (terminalCylinder^4)) +
      (24*(T:ℝ)) • pairing 2 (by norm_num) T hT (core (1:Cylinder)))
        (core (terminalCylinder^4)) = 19584*(T:ℝ)^2 := by
  simp only [add_apply, smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
  rw [pairing_core_real, ← pow_add, terminal_moments,
    pairing_core_real, one_mul, terminal_moments]
  have h4 := PseudoPolynomialStein.moment_multiple 4 (by norm_num) (-(T:ℝ)) 1
  have h8 := PseudoPolynomialStein.moment_multiple 4 (by norm_num) (-(T:ℝ)) 2
  norm_num [neg_pow] at h4 h8 ⊢
  nlinarith [h4,h8]
